newsitem.title: DENMARK: ISS gets 700 mln DKK Unibank facility.
newsitem.headline: ISS gets 700 mln DKK Unibank facility.

text.p: Danish cleaning group ISS said on Tuesday it had agreed a five-year, 700 million crown, funding facility with Unibank, reducing its 1.25 billion short-term facility by a similar amount.

In a statement accompanying its first half results, ISS (International Service System) added that shares and property pledged to the bank under the short-term agreement had been released as part of the new deal.

"The release of the securities and the new long-term facility represent a major step for ISS in relation to the establishment of a funding base which is consistent with the group's overall growth strategy," it said.
The statement added that free cash flow rose to 97 million crowns in the first half of 1997 from 54 million during the same period last year.
The flow was helped by a 27 million crown rise in operating profit and a decrease of 54 million in tax payments, it said.

The group, which was hit heavily last year by falsified accounting in U.S. unit ISS Inc, reported first half 1997 net profit of 83 million crowns compared to a loss of 2.02 billion in the first six months of 1996.
It said that earnings per share grew to 2.79 crowns from 1.21 over the same period.
